market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and CPI tick-up drive rate expectations higher, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. 4th consecutive down day suggests momentum shift. Watch for 10Y yield breaking 5% as psychological trigger. Energy sector outperforms; consumer and growth underperform. Crypto weak. Expect volatility to remain elevated through Fed decision.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle and cloud infrastructure growth (ORCL, MRVL) provide structural earnings support. Energy transition and critical minerals create multi-year investment themes. However, sustained oil above $100 risks stagflation. Fed hiking cycle likely 1-2 more moves before pause. Housing suppressed by 7%+ mortgages. Private credit and tokenization offer alternative yield. 12-month view: equity recovery likely post-rate peak, but path is bumpy.
